profile.summary: Customer support team lead for a B2B payments product.

bullets: Led a team of 9 support agents handling 2,400 tickets a month in Zendesk.
Raised CSAT from 82% to 91% by rewriting 35 help-centre articles and macros.
Handled escalations for 40 enterprise merchants within a 4-hour SLA.
Resolved 70 payment and settlement tickets a day by phone and email.
